text:
elaine: Heads-up — prepping release notes & internal announce for the small rollout next week. Target cutover Mon 2026-03-23 16:00 PT. Need concise internal blurb, pin, and deploybot cue.

simon: I can draft the blurb. Any embargoes or hard-stop windows?

marcos: EU maintenance window 15:30-17:30 UTC that day — avoid any customer-facing blasts during that overlap. Also pin to eng and product channels?

elaine: yes pin in eng-releases and product. Audience: internal eng, support, and account execs for private customers. Also: version pin for deployment: runtime v2.4.1 (primary), fallback v2.3.9-quant.

ops-bot: Reminder — rollback policy: auto-rollback if 5xx rate > 1% sustained for 10m during canary. Manual rollback allowed by oncall. Use /deploy override to continue.

simon: Draft blurb — "Planned rollout Mon 03/23 16:00 PT: runtime v2.4.1 (pinned), fallback v2.3.9-quant. Expected user impact: negligible; improvements to KV-cache stability and tokenization corner-case. Ops on standby; rollback criteria in place. Please route support questions to #support and tag @oncall." Thoughts?

kelly: Nice — shorten the first sentence. Suggest: "Planned rollout Mon 03/23 16:00 PT: runtime v2.4.1 (pinned)." Move the impact line after ops on standby. Add note for private deploy customers: KMS rotation safe.

elaine: updated ask: keep a single-paragraph internal blurb + 2 bullet lines (rollout timeline, rollback rules). Can someone finalize & pin?

marcos: Ops confirm readiness. Canary lanes: 10% -> 50% at +15m -> 100% at +45m. Canary runtime metrics monitored: tail latency p95, error % and model output quality probe.

ryan: I'll be oncall 15:45-18:00 PT. Cherry-pick list: hotfix for kv-cache TTL and a small tokenizer patch (PRs 4521, 4523). If rollback happens, I'll trigger pinned deploy -> stable v2.3.9.

simon: Final blurb ready: "Planned rollout Mon 03/23 16:00 PT: runtime v2.4.1 (pinned) with fallback to v2.3.9-quant. Timeline: canary 10% -> 50% (+15m) -> 100% (+45m). Rollback: automatic on sustained 5xx >1% for 10m, manual ops rollback available. Impact: improvements to KV-cache stability and tokenization fixes; no customer action required. Ops & oncall monitoring in place." OK to pin this?

elaine: LGTM. Please include the short ops checklist under the thread when you pin: 1) deploybot cue + rollback policy, 2) oncall contact @ryan, 3) postmortem owner = simon.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot scheduled canary: 2026-03-23T23:00:00Z (canary 10% -> 50% @+15m -> 100% @+45m). Rollback automation hooked (threshold: 5xx >1% 10m).

elaine: Thanks all. Simon — can you pin the blurb to eng-releases and product, and schedule the deploy-bot cue?

simon: Pinning now and scheduled the cue. Posting the pinned blurb and ops checklist in 1 min. 

elaine: perfect :thumbsup:
